name: Rise of Olympus

features.name: God powers
features.description: Zeus, Hades and Poseidon each have a different random grid modifier.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Choose a god and a multiplier that grows with each cascade.

review:
Greek gods on a cascading grid, years before Gates of Olympus. Zeus turns symbols wild, Hades removes a symbol type, and Poseidon transforms a set of symbols into one – and they can trigger at random after a dead spin, so the base game rarely feels empty.

In free spins you choose a god, getting their power plus a multiplier that grows with each cascade. A good pick if Gates of Olympus feels too swingy. High volatility, 5,000x max, top RTP 96.5%.
